title: Maximum floor area ratio for a mixed use building in a Special Mixed Use District
previewText: The maximum floor area ratio for zoning lots containing a mixed use building in a Special Mixed Use District shall be in accordance with the provisions of Section 123-62 (Special Floor Area Regulations).
